patterns.note: A dense, irregular grid of photographic thumbnails is used to display portfolio content, allowing for varied aspect ratios and visual interest without strict alignment.
The site uses a prominent, elegant serif font for the main name and introductory text, contrasted with a clean, understated sans-serif for functional elements like navigation and subheadings.
A minimalist white background provides a clean canvas, allowing the rich, natural tones and vibrant colors within the photographic content to dominate the visual experience.
The initial hero image at the top of the page exhibits a strong parallax effect, scrolling slower than the page content to reveal an introductory text block positioned behind it.
The site features a distinct 'journal' text section that is revealed through a scroll-triggered parallax effect of the hero image, acting as an introduction to the portfolio.

technique_notes: The main site title is fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining brand presence throughout the scroll. The secondary navigation elements disappear as the user scrolls down.

The hero image employs a significant parallax scroll effect, moving at a slower rate than the main page content. This creates a layered depth, revealing an introductory text block that was initially obscured behind it.

Portfolio content is presented in a flexible, non-uniform grid layout, where images of various sizes and aspect ratios are arranged to fill available space, creating a dynamic and visually rich display.

design_tokens.type_scale: A large, elegant serif heading (~3x body) is used for the main name, complemented by a smaller, clean sans-serif for subheadings and navigation, and a readable serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp — all elements and images maintain crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy around the header and footer, creating a sense of openness, while the image grid is dense, maximizing visual content in a compact area.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the scroll-triggered parallax hero image that reveals an introductory text block. This creates an engaging and unique entry point to the site's content, moving beyond a static hero section.
